name: Will Kline
summary: Full-stack software engineer (Angular/TypeScript, C#/.NET, SQL Server) who works directly with enterprise clients to turn their needs into shipped software, often within the same day. Conservatory-trained bassist (Indiana University Jacobs School of Music; Aspen Music Festival) who brings an ensemble player's instinct for communication and a performer's standard of craft.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.note: GiddyUp: a configurable CRM serving hundreds of companies, including SRS, Heritage, and Sherwin-Williams.
bullets: Engineer on the two-person Enterprise Integrations team, building custom contractor-management apps (project bidding, multi-contractor workflows) for enterprise clients; work praised by client executive leadership and later released to all customers.

Work directly with client engineering and management teams, turning their requests into tested, deployed features, often within the same day; currently building public APIs that a client's team is building an app on.
Designed and built GiddyUp Teams, including a round-robin assignment algorithm. Built for one client, then released platform-wide and adopted internally.
Built the Procore integration for construction takeoffs: create from scratch, import items, upload material spreadsheets, manage access, and link directly into Procore.
Designed and built the calendar and Kanban project views and redesigned the job-intake form for an enterprise client's app.

Rewrote legacy SQL behind enterprise-scale screens: a 60,000-job list from ~30s (often timing out) to ~11s, and a Kanban board from 17s to 2s. Regularly untangle and modernize inherited code across database and application layers.
Early adopter of AI-assisted development (ChatGPT, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Claude); now build with Claude daily across design, implementation, debugging, and refactoring.

Elected team lead for a company Innovation Day: gathered requirements from leaders of our largest clients, split the team between ship-now features and a vision mockup, and shipped more production changes than any other team.

Served on the deployment team running 4 AM production releases roughly every 1.5 weeks. Represent engineering at industry trade shows (e.g., FRSA Convention & Florida Roofing & Sheet Metal Expo) and handle booth logistics: shipping, setup, and teardown.

additional_experience: Delivery Driver (Top Dasher), DoorDash, 2020–2023: 3,000+ deliveries with near-perfect ratings. Production Associate, API Trucast (aerospace casting), 2018–2019: trained new hires on 3+ processes.
music: Principal Bassist, Indiana University New Music Ensemble (2019–2022): premieres and commissions by student, faculty, and guest composers, often working directly with composers in rehearsal.

Assistant Principal Bass, Carmel Symphony Orchestra (2021–2023): 2–6 concerts per month, including school and community outreach; relayed direction from conductor and principals to the section; adapted to 1–2 guest soloists and conductors monthly.

Aspen Music Festival and School (2022): Aspen Festival Orchestra, Aspen Chamber Symphony, and Aspen Contemporary Ensemble; performed with Augustin Hadelich and Joyce Yang; masterclasses with Edgar Meyer; performed an original solo bass composition on a soloists' recital.
Chautauqua Institution School of Music (2019): Music School Festival Orchestra; performed an original solo bass composition on a soloists' recital.
Texas Music Festival, University of Houston (2018).
Auditioned for the Atlanta Symphony Orchestra and Pittsburgh Symphony Orchestra.

Composer and producer: 14 self-released albums, EPs, and projects (2016–present), written, performed, recorded, mixed, and mastered independently in Ableton Live and Max/MSP; distributed via DistroKid to Spotify, Apple Music, and other platforms.

Teaching: coached bass sectionals for school and youth orchestras (including paid sectional coaching for an Indianapolis youth orchestra); private bass instruction; frequent outreach performances in schools and senior centers.

education.school: Indiana University Jacobs School of Music
education.detail: Performer Diploma, Solo Performance – Double Bass (2022) · Bachelor of Music in Performance, Double Bass (orchestral) (2020) · Honors student; Founders Scholar; Dean's List; Arthur R. Metz Scholar; graduated with honors
